_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Grace, Lady Wallace (1804-1878): the letters of Mozart (2 vols), Beethoven (2 vols) and Mendelssohn (2 vols), Letters of Distinguished Musicians (1867), Nohl's Life of Mozart (2 vols, 1877), Polko's Reminiscences of Mendelssohn (1869), Palleske's Schiller's Life and Works (2 vols, 1860), Grimm's Alexandra Feodorowna (2 vols, 1870), Fernán Caballero's The Castle and the Cottage in Spain (2 vols, 1861), and Auerbach's Joseph in the Snow (3 vols). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 23), widened in round 104 from period archive.org scans; Adam may veto. No uids minted.
